description: This PHP class 'BuzzShareModel' represents a data model for sharing buzz posts within the OrangeHRM system. It serializes BuzzShare entities, specifies filtering, and attribute naming for API responses.

classes.name: BuzzShareModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes BuzzShare entities for API responses, including filters and attribute mappings.

methods.description: Initializes the BuzzShareModel with a BuzzShare entity, setting entity, filters, and attribute names.
